description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractUploader' used for managing multipart uploads in the AWS SDK, handling streams and parts of files, creating upload commands, and managing the upload process.

classes.name: AbstractUploader
classes.description: An abstract class that manages multipart upload logic, including source stream handling, creating upload parts, and generating upload commands

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the uploader with an AWS client, data source, and configuration.

methods.name: limitPartStream
methods.description: Limits the stream to a specific part size for uploading.

methods.name: getUploadCommands
methods.description: Generates a sequence of upload commands for each part of the data.

methods.name: createPart
methods.description: Abstract method to create metadata for an upload part.

methods.name: isEof
methods.description: Checks if the source data has reached EOF.

methods.name: determineSource
methods.description: Converts the provided source into a readable stream, accepting filenames or streams.

methods.name: getNumberOfParts
methods.description: Calculates the total number of parts based on source size and part size.
